title.en: The Generative Gap Between Speculative Drafter and Continuous Diffusion Language Model
title.zh: 推测解码草稿模型与连续扩散语言模型的生成差距

summary.en: A controlled comparison of standalone drafting and continuous diffusion under matched training budgets, examining recurrent memory and iterative full-sequence refinement without target-model verification.
summary.zh: 在匹配训练预算、无需目标模型验证的设置下，对比独立草稿模型与连续扩散语言模型，研究循环记忆与全序列迭代细化的作用。

alt.en: Conceptual comparison of a Markov drafting head, a recurrent drafting head, and LangFlow under shared evaluation without target-model verification.
alt.zh: 在无需目标模型验证的共同评测设置下，对比 Markov 草稿头、循环草稿头与 LangFlow 的方法示意动图。

caption.zh: 方法示意 · 独立生成能力对比
